Market today: The mood is mixed for tech/chips. Positive news for flash memory and some AI stocks from analysts, but a "red flag" from OpenAI's talent exodus adds caution. Tariffs on foreign components could also shift some tech focus domestically.

Your holdings: SOXL (-43.03%) and SPAL (-39.64%) are your biggest concerns. Both are leveraged ETFs with significant drawdowns, amplified by margin. These need immediate attention to manage risk.

Watch: Keep an eye on broader AI sentiment given the OpenAI news. Also, watch for follow-through in flash memory names after the SanDisk update, as several chip names are showing long setups.

Bottom line: Prioritize managing risk in your leveraged positions while selectively looking for high-conviction opportunities in core chip names.
plays: Immediately re-evaluate risk management for SOXL and SPAL; both leveraged ETFs show severe drawdowns and their listed stops are now above current prices.
Consider a new buy in MU (Micron) given the positive SanDisk news and its strong scanner setup: entry 965.01-963.5, stop 956.39.
